units.source_text: 她的姨母大弍夫人闻知此事，想道：“果然不出我之所料！

en.t: When her aunt, Lady Daini, heard of this, she thought, "It has turned out exactly as I expected!

units.source_text: 那样孤苦命穷而不体面的人，有谁肯来爱她？

en.t: Who would ever be willing to love someone so lonely, unfortunate, and undignified as that?

units.source_text: 佛菩萨也要挑罪孽较轻的人才肯接引呢。

en.t: Even the Buddhas and bodhisattvas choose people with lighter sins before they agree to lead them to salvation.

units.source_text: 境况如此穷困，而神气如此十足，竟同父母在世之时一样骄傲，真可怜啊！”

en.t: Her circumstances are so poor, yet she carries herself with such pride, just as arrogantly as when her parents were alive. How pitiful!"

units.source_text: 她更加觉得末摘花太傻了，教人对她说道：“还是打定主意跟我走吧！

en.t: She felt all the more that Suetsumuhana was foolish, and sent someone to tell her, "You should make up your mind and come with me after all.

units.source_text: 须知身受‘世间苦’的人，‘窜入深山’都不辞劳呢。

en.t: You should know that people who suffer the hardships of this world do not even shrink from fleeing deep into the mountains.

units.source_text: 你以为乡间生活不舒服么？

en.t: Do you think life in the countryside would be uncomfortable?

units.source_text: 我管教你不吃苦头。”话说得很好听。

en.t: I will make sure you do not suffer." The words sounded very pleasant.

units.source_text: 几个侍女都已垂头丧气，私下愤愤不平地议论：“听了姨母的话多么好呢！

en.t: Several of the serving women had already lost heart, and privately grumbled in resentment, "How much better it would be if she listened to her aunt!
She will never have better fortune in this life.

units.source_text: 她这么顽固，不知道是什么意思。”

en.t: What can she mean by being so stubborn?"
